messages:
alex_p: Heads-up — drafting the PRD section for SLO/SLA for the Fast-Failover initiative. Need to finalize targets & launch criteria by EOD Wed.

sara_sre: quick q: are these for Hosted only or do they include Dedicated/Private?

alex_p: both. Proposed baseline: Hosted text-gen (seq<=128): p95 <= 150ms, p99 <= 450ms, monthly error rate <= 0.1%. Dedicated SLA: 99.9% regional uptime, latency objective p99 <= 1s for seq<=512. Error budget for Dedicated handled via capacity commit, billing-level credits for breaches.

jamal_platform: cost/ops note — p95 150ms for Hosted at scale needs aggressive batching + more GPUs. We should allow an SLO band for cold-starts: 99th cold-start <= 2s (warming allowed). Also support degradation path: fallback to 'redwood-small' when GPU pool saturated.

kevin_design: how will UX surface degraded results? Do we show a spinner or message? propose: small banner: "Degraded mode: response may be shorter" + telemetry opt-in.

sara_sre: acceptance criteria request:
- SLOs defined per model/profile
- End-to-end measurement in prod via synthetic traffic
- Error budget burn alerts at 25/50/80%
- Automated rollback/fallback when burn rate high

alex_p: acceptance criteria (draft):
- Performance: hosted p95/p99 as above measured over 30 days baseline
- Reliability: automated fallback triggers within 30s of breach
- Observability: dashboard with per-route latency, error, tokens
- Test harness with synthetic traffic and canary run

jamal_platform: edge cases: long sequences (>1024) fall back to non-preemptive queue; API returns 429 if queued > 5s. Also provide 'priority' header for enterprise.

kevin_design: UX acceptance: error banners use standard style, no modal; user can retry with 'force' flag.

ops_bot: deploy scheduled: canary=service/fast-failover v1.2 -> 1749003000

sara_sre: +1. I'll create SLO dashboard and alert playbook. tagging @oncall.

alex_p: thanks. please add comments inline on the PRD doc. I'm locking scope: MVP excludes embeddings-based reranking and instrumented A/B traffic shaping (phase 2).
